name: min_parallel_table_scan_size
description: Sets the minimum estimated table data size (in 8kB blocks) below which the planner will not consider a parallel table scan.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans for large tables
Unnecessarily slow sequential scans on large tables
tuning_tips: Increase this value to suppress parallel scans on moderately sized tables where overhead outweighs benefits; decrease to enable parallelism on smaller tables when I/O and CPU resources permit. Monitor EXPLAIN output and actual parallel worker usage to validate impact.
